rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance - annual maximum rent increase
rules.requirement: A landlord may raise rent only once a year by no more than the lesser of 3% of current rent or 80% of the CPI change. The City publishes the maximum allowable increase for each period; it is 2.87% for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027. Tenants and landlords may petition for review of increases, rent reductions and pass-through costs. Landlords may charge a registration-fee pass-through of up to $50 per rental unit (not per tenant) and must reimburse any overcharge.
rules.key_value: Lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change; 2.87% for 9/1/2026-8/31/2027; registration fee pass-through max $50 per unit

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: A landlord must have a valid reason to evict, such as non-payment of rent, breach of the lease, or the landlord wanting to move into the property. For certain evictions the landlord may have to help pay the tenant's moving costs (relocation assistance).
